messages.subject: Hello World!!!
parts:
Greetings to all!

I'm a penultimate year Computer Science undergraduate at GLA University, Mathura, India. 

I have some prior experience with R, as I have completed a few courses on Datacamp. While going through the GSoC 2019 projects, I am really interested in the following projects:

1. RcppMLPACK
2. COIN-OR Bridge and Solver

Having completed a project in Machine Learning and currently doing one in the same field has given me some exposure to ML. My passion for programming, especially in C++ and python will help me in writing the code for the required packages. 

I am working on the tests for the projects and look forward to collaborate in either.

Regards,
